title: Rejecting from a restoring transition
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean word, $st$ an access state, and $i,k,p$ natural numbers with $i\le |y|+1$ and $k\le |y|+1$. If, for every optional Boolean symbol $a$ and every work-head reading function $w$, the transition from $st$ is the action that moves work tape $2$ one cell left and enters the restoring state with no equality result, then there is a finite safe computation path from the configuration with state $st$ and parameters $i,k,p$ to the configuration with rejecting answer and parameters $0,k,p$.
hypotheses_covered: transition condition for every optional bit a and reading function w
